paragraphs: As of March 31, 2026, we had additional leases, primarily for datacenters, that had not yet commenced of $ 196.6 billion. These leases will commence between fiscal year 2026 and fiscal year 2031 with lease terms of 1 year to 21 years.

paragraphs: As of June 30, 2026, we had additional leases, primarily for datacenters, that had not yet commenced of $ 329.1 billion, with some arrangements subject to certain contractual conditions being met.
